citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:28 PM on
9/4/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by telephone and was sent directly to voicemail. The APHIS
Official left a message introducing himself and the purpose of the call. The licensee did not respond/return the call. Failure
to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
